reason: A DeepSeek Harness web client plugin that detects Mermaid fenced code blocks and renders them as interactive SVG diagrams while preserving source-code controls and theme adaptation.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中将 Markdown 的 Mermaid 围栏代码块渲染为可切换的 SVG 图表。
summaries.en: Renders Mermaid fenced code blocks as switchable SVG diagrams in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Loads Mermaid JavaScript from a configurable CDN
Replaces Mermaid code blocks with rendered SVG diagrams
Adds controls and styles to the web interface
